name: pick_lid_stop_block_left
feature: the left stop block, 4 mm down its contact face and 1.5 mm behind it (D38): the material the pick lid's lug bears on. The face is perpendicular to the 43.8 degree pick plane; the lid has nothing else that stops it sliding down the slope (the skirt hangs outside the front face and does not)

name: pick_lid_stop_block_right
feature: the right stop block, 4 mm down its contact face and 1.5 mm behind it (D38): the material the pick lid's lug bears on. The face is perpendicular to the 43.8 degree pick plane; the lid has nothing else that stops it sliding down the slope (the skirt hangs outside the front face and does not)

name: rail_buttress_right_back
feature: the skin of the buttress carrying the rear joining groove, between the groove's bottom and the hopper's interior: wall_out + rail_boss - 5.4 = 4.4 thick since D39 (2.4 before)

name: rail_skin_right_front
feature: the same skin behind the front groove (D39), the stretch that stood as a thin blade inside tray A where the pick plane cuts the buttress and tore in test prints 1 and 2

name: cubby_deck
feature: the deck between the accessory cubby and the crossing chute above it -- 3mm at the back face, thickening toward the front because the cubby ceiling runs at 45 degrees while the chute floor runs at 40 (D21); here, mid-cubby, it is about 12.7

name: vault_deck
feature: the deck between the vault ridge of bay 3's chute ceiling and hopper B's floor above it, mid-leg: chute_ceil (3mm) at the ridge, the thinnest the deck under hopper B gets after the vault (D26)
